charts.title: LHS 3844 b: orbits around Batsũ̀
charts.description: The orbits of Batsũ̀'s planets in this map from above, to scale, with LHS 3844 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Nagel et al. 2026 (2026A&A...710A.311N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NAGEL_ET_AL_2026): P 0.462929709 d

charts.title: LHS 3844 b: its transit
charts.description: LHS 3844 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (102, 103, 104) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 410153553, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
